title: Aina za nomino (Theme 2: Huduma ya kwanza)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child knows nouns of wingi (maji, mafuta, maziwa, mate) name things that are not counted one by one and stay in the plural.

floor.prerequisite: Gives the plural of a noun.
floor.question: Wingi wa kitabu ni?

representations: a jug of water and cups
steps: Ask: can I count it one by one?
If not, it is a noun of wingi.
Use it with mengi or a measure.
contexts: first aid (huduma ya kwanza): water and oil

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes two sentences: "Maji ni mengi" and one with a measure.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kitabu kimoja, vitabu viwili. Andika wingi wa "kitabu"." Kwa nini "kitabu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Wingi wa nomino nyingi hubadilisha mwanzo wa neno, si mwisho. Kitabu kimoja, vitabu viwili.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Wingi wa "mtoto" ni ___." Kwa nini "vitoto" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kiambishi cha wingi hutegemea ngeli ya nomino. Watu hupewa wa- (watoto), na vitu kama kitabu hupewa vi- (vitabu).

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Wingi wa "mti" ni ___." Kwa nini "mimiti" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino ina kiambishi kimoja cha wingi tu. Mti mmoja, miti miwili.
Nomino za wingi kama maji hazihesabiki: maji mengi, glasi mbili za maji.

checks.question: Ni nomino ipi ya wingi: kitabu, maziwa, kiti?
